speaker: Speaker 2
text: Namaste Rakesh ji. Main menu costing ke baare mein call kar rahi thi. Aapne jo naya menu bheja tha, uski costing humne nikaal li hai.

speaker: Speaker 1
text: Achha. Toh food cost kitna aa raha hai?

speaker: Speaker 2
text: Abhi food cost 41 percent aa raha hai, target 34 percent ka hai. Paneer aur dairy ke rates sabse zyada badhe hain.

speaker: Speaker 1
text: Haan, dairy wala har mahine rate badha deta hai. Pichhle mahine sirf dairy ka bill 1.8 lakh aaya tha.

speaker: Speaker 2
text: Isiliye mujhe aapke vendor bills chahiye, last teen mahine ke. Unse hum dekh lenge kahan negotiate kar sakte hain.

speaker: Speaker 1
text: Theek hai, main kal tak saare vendor bills WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon.

speaker: Speaker 2
text: Perfect. Aur main revised menu costing Friday tak bhej dungi, portion size ke saath.

speaker: Speaker 1
text: Friday theek hai. Bas dhyan rakhna ki dishes ke rate customer ke liye zyada na badhein.

speaker: Speaker 2
text: Bilkul, selling price same rakhenge, portion aur recipe se cost kam karenge.

speaker: Speaker 1
text: Achha hai. Monday ko phir call karte hain, tab costing dekh lenge.

speaker: Speaker 2
text: Haan, Monday ko main call karti hoon. Thank you Rakesh ji.
